metadata.title: Vintage Country Rock Album Cover
useCases: Album art for 1970s style rock or country bands

retrievalProfile.description: A 1970s-style trio portrait featuring warm studio lighting, western-inspired attire, and heavy, outlined display typography against a saturated red-orange background.

recipe.visualDefinition: A tight, triangular composition of three men with 1970s hairstyles and facial hair, wearing western vests and hats, set against a vibrant, flat red-orange backdrop with bold, heavy-weight display text at the top.
coreVisualRelationships: Triangular arrangement of subjects creating depth
High-contrast between dark clothing and bright background
Typography overlapping the top subject's hat
Warm, directional studio lighting emphasizing facial features
coreInvariants: Heavy black display type with white inline or outline

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Three subjects in a tiered arrangement: one central and slightly higher, flanked by two lower subjects in the foreground.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The central figure wearing a black cowboy hat.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the bold top typography, moves down to the central hatted figure, then circulates between the two flanking faces.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Minimal; the subjects and large typography fill approximately 85% of the frame.

colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep browns and blacks in clothing and hair
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Bright yellow and white in shirts and typographic outlines
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the background with mid-to-low value subjects to create a pop-out effect.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Extra-bold, ultra-wide sans-serif with rounded terminals
letterConstructionRules: Heavy black fill with a thin white interior inline
Slightly curved baseline for the main title
characterSpecificRedesigns: The 'A' has a very low crossbar
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Heavy, rounded display face paired with a traditional, high-contrast serif for secondary information.
graphicDevices: White inline stroke on primary text

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the heavy, rounded, multi-line aesthetic
Captures the 70s rounded heavy sans-serif feel
Appropriate for the era and weight, though less wide

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a studio portrait of three men in 1970s western attire (vests, cowboy hat, sideburns) against a solid, saturated red-orange background. Use warm, directional lighting.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a large, heavy, black display title at the top with a white inline effect. Place a smaller lowercase serif subtitle directly beneath the first word of the title.

verificationChecks: Is the background a vibrant red-orange?
Does the main text have a white inline or outline?
Are the subjects arranged in a tiered, triangular group?
Is the typography heavy and tightly tracked?

mustAchieve: Authentic 1970s film grain and color grading

postGenerationChecks: Check for 1970s period accuracy in hair and clothing
Ensure text is legible despite tight tracking
Verify the red-orange background is sufficiently saturated
Confirm the triangular composition of the trio
recipe.reuseFormula: 1970s Trio Portrait + Saturated Red-Orange Backdrop + Heavy Rounded Display Type
